description: This file contains an extension of the CanvasWindowController class implementing the WKNavigationDelegate methods for handling web view navigation policies and actions, including deep links and URL opening behavior within a macOS application.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A controller managing a canvas-based window, extended here to handle web navigation events.

methods.name: webView(_:decidePolicyFor:decisionHandler:)
methods.description: Determines whether to allow or cancel a navigation action based on the URL scheme, handling deep links and external URL opening.

methods.name: webView(_:didFinish:)
methods.description: Called when a web navigation finishes; applies debug status if needed.
